fixed.summary: Destroying a renderer no longer waits for the full pipeline variants still compiling in the background: they finish on the compile workers, and the process waits for them only when it exits. With an empty shader cache a renderer's destruction right after its first frame took 3.0 s on a software Vulkan adapter (materials scene) and about 0.7 s on Metal (terrain scene); it now takes 20–30 ms.
